llm.summary: This skill is a local browser-based note, image, and document organizer with disclosed local storage and no evidence of network upload or hidden execution.

dimensions.detail: It uses browser localStorage, IndexedDB, FileReader, clipboard write, and Blob downloads, which are proportionate to the stated local note and file-management purpose.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill is delivered as SKILL.md plus a static HTML asset, with an optional packaging command using skill-creator; no dependencies, installers, or executable startup hooks are present.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: Runtime actions are user-directed through the HTML UI, clipboard paste, drag-and-drop, file selection, copy, delete, and download controls; no prompt-injection or role-changing instructions were found.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Notes, drafts, trash, folder metadata, image blobs, and uploaded file blobs persist in the browser profile until the user deletes them; this is disclosed and purpose-aligned, but not encrypted.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

dimensions.detail: The artifacts consistently describe and implement a single-file front-end tool for collecting text, managing pasted or uploaded images/files, and exporting notes to .docx.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

llm.guidance: Install only if you want a local browser tool that keeps notes, pasted images, and uploaded files in that browser profile. Avoid storing highly sensitive material on shared devices or profiles unless you are comfortable with browser-local persistence.
